title: Newton International Fellowships
about: Royal Society Newton International Fellowships, 2027 round: opens 13 January 2027 and closes 10 March 2027, with decisions on 23 August 2027. For researchers with a PhD and no more than five years' postdoctoral experience; sponsors may support one application per round.
requirements: PhD awarded or thesis defended by the closing date
No more than five years' active full-time postdoctoral experience post-PhD
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for Newton International Fellowships from The Royal Society, United Kingdom, deadline 10 Mar 2027. The photo shows Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament and Westminster Bridge in London; the host city depends on the host institution.
